semantics.value_rule: Instant representation is exact under declared profile.
semantics.precision_rule: Temporal precision is explicit where material.
semantics.timezone_rule: Display timezone does not change instant identity.
semantics.ordering_rule: Instant order is temporal evidence only and not causal order by itself.
semantics.authority_rule: Current/earlier/later status does not imply authorization except where explicit time gate uses it.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
